title: testfocus regex flags .fit( calls as focused test false positive
description: Regex class [^A-Za-z0-9_] matches '.', causing .fit(X_train, y_train) sklearn calls to be flagged as focused tests. Fix: Add '.' to character class.

title: Majority-vote baseline double-counts one defect as two
description: jq logic excludes findings only by direct membership, not transitively. When defects match via different paths, both representations land in baseline.json, inflating baseline_count and depressing parity_pct.

title: CLAUDE.md still says plugin is not here yet but has been added
description: Scope section claims plugin doesn't exist, but branch adds .claude-plugin/, commands/, skills/, agents/, and eval/. Stale documentation misleads readers about what is outstanding.

title: match.sh's matches-at-most-once invariant is documented but unenforced
description: Validation doesn't enforce that each finding matches at most once. Duplicate a_idx/b_idx pairs can result in parity_pct > 100%.

title: Stale /reviso review (no colon) left after namespace established
description: Line 7 uses /reviso review instead of /reviso:review. Same issue in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/false-positive.yml:53 and bug.yml:36.
